Experience with electrical systems, UPS, HVAC, cooling systems, and power distribution in data center environments. Familiarity with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools including telemetry ingestion and capacity analytics. Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools such as Grafana, Power BI, or Tableau. Experience with automation/scripting using Python or PowerShell. Knowledge of the ITIL framework and IT service management best practices. Preferred Qualifications NFPA 70E (Arc Flash) Electrical Safety certification Data Center Energy Practitioner (DCEP) DCIM/BMS/SCADA certifications.
